landing.title: Stop chasing clients for their logo on WhatsApp
landing.subtitle: Briefly collects everything you need before building a client's website — business details, copy, references and files — through a single, friendly link.
landing.step1Text: Pick a template and a client. The questionnaire is ready in seconds.
landing.step2Text: Your client fills it in step by step from their phone, saves and comes back later.
landing.step3Text: Answers organised by section, files ready to download and export to Markdown or JSON.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for freelancers and small studios
landing.feature1Text: Clear steps, progress bar and autosave. No account needed for your client.
landing.feature2Text: Logos and photos are checked, stripped of metadata and stored privately.
landing.feature3Text: Each brief gets its own link that you can expire or revoke at any time.
landing.feature4Text: Run it with Docker in minutes. AGPL-3.0 licensed, no vendor lock-in.
landing.footer: Briefly is free and open-source software released under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
